verdict: Spend was throttled back; the deeper issue is intake, not ads volume.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 10 leads at an average cost of $246.88 each, with zero new leads arriving in the most recent 7 days. Google Ads spend dropped sharply this week — this was a deliberate throttle, not a platform error, and is tied directly to an unresolved gap in your intake process: with the dispatch seat vacant since early July, speed-to-lead follow-up has no owner, and 73 open pipeline opportunities have produced zero booked appointments. Increasing ad budget before that seat is filled would spend money without capturing jobs, so spend stays controlled until intake ownership is confirmed. Once that is resolved, we are ready to scale back up immediately.
